result.title: SFL Annotations with LLM CLI Coding Agents

answers.answer: All four: vibe, agy, claude, opencode via an extensible adapter interface
Default to parent-chunk batching with single-clause fallback and configurable batch size
Hybrid: Deterministic spaCy pass 1 + CLI agent pass 2 (mood, modality, tenor) with ideational validation

Core Engine Factory: Configurable via settings/env for transparent use in TUI and Web Corpus Explorer
Dedicated CLI Command: e.g. 'notebooklm corpus sfl' or 'notebooklm sfl annotate'
Retry with JSON repair, optional fallback to default DSPy engine if agent fails
